scenes.text: Studying with your phone face-down on the desk still counts as studying with your phone.

scenes.title: One timer, 50 minutes.
scenes.body: Write the **one task** you'll finish before it rings.

scenes.title: Block the laptop too.
scenes.body: Your worst sites are blocked for the 50 minutes — **no "quick check."**

scenes.title: 10-minute break, then phone.
scenes.body: The phone is **the reward,** not the interruption.

scenes.sub: Plus the laptop + phone blocker setup.
